title: deep-equal
standardAlternative: node:util isDeepStrictEqual (or node:assert deepEqual/deepStrictEqual in a try block).
notes: tape 5.10.3 is the newest release in upstream's ^5.7.2 range (upstream's own test helper test/_tape.js extends tape/lib/test, which 5.10.3 still provides). test/cmp.js runs directly with the node runner, with tape-isolation.cjs preloaded (--require): plain tape lets an exception thrown inside one test callback (for example a stack overflow on a circular input) end the whole file, so the preload reports it as a failed assertion and ends that test instead. The reference passes every test with or without it. ../assert.js is vendored for test/_tape.js; it is only used when the ASSERT environment variable is set, which the grader never sets.
